title: A packet of documents for one application
description: The resume, the letter and any extra details are assembled into one consistent version.

blocks.text: Several files are easy to mix up during an active job search. A matching style is no guarantee that the recipient and the content line up.

quote.text: I needed help but didn't realize how much help I needed until I saw what this app could do for me. I love the cover letter from the moment I saw it created for me.

blocks.text: Tie the documents to the posting that was chosen and check the fields they share. Before sending, show what is included and which versions the attachments are.
Referees’ contact details and personal information call for a deliberate choice. Don’t carry them automatically into every new packet.
